reason: Backend quality-check routing and architecture checklist.
Verify no secret values cross protocol, logs, persistence, exports, or cache.
Verify sparse non-secret configuration and precedence behavior.
Verify migrations, single-writer ownership, transactionality, and rollback evidence.
Verify stable error codes, sanitized diagnostics, retryability, timeout, and cancellation.
Run the required lint, typecheck, tests, and diff checks without false-green package commands.
Check protocol-to-service-to-HTTP-to-persistence data flow and ownership boundaries.
Check every Hindsight endpoint/schema/version claim against generated/OpenAPI sources.
Validate implementation and tests against the accepted Hindsight contract research.
Validate that new wiring matches current composition and does not assume missing Shell/Core capabilities.
